Sample Birthday Itineraries

Bar Crawl Birthday (6 hours)

7:00 PM - Pickup (birthday decorations ready)
7:30 PM - Dinner at birthday guest's favorite spot
9:30 PM - First bar/club in Old Town
10:30 PM - Second venue
11:30 PM - Third venue (cake presentation)
1:00 AM - Return home

Day Adventure Birthday (8 hours)

10:00 AM - Pickup with brunch provisions
11:00 AM - Brunch at Hash Kitchen
1:00 PM - Shopping at Fashion Square
3:00 PM - Pool party at W Scottsdale
6:00 PM - Return to freshen up

Wine Country Birthday (7 hours)

10:00 AM - Depart Phoenix
12:00 PM - First winery (Page Springs)
2:00 PM - Lunch at Alcantara
4:00 PM - Final tasting (Javelina Leap)
5:30 PM - Return to Phoenix
